title: Private bounded argv execution qualification
objective: Qualify a provider-internal Windows executor for one deterministic fixed inbox child with no arguments with AppContainer identity, kill-on-close Job lifecycle, scrubbed environment, an explicit three-handle inheritance allowlist, workspace-bound cwd, bounded stdout/stderr capture, and verified process-tree quiescence, without exposing process.spawn through policy, cotrad, or MCP.

include: explicit absolute executable and fixed argv validation
workspace-bound cwd validation and CreateProcessW binding
AppContainer suspended launch and token verification
Job assignment and membership before resume
NUL stdin plus bounded stdout/stderr through an explicit three-handle inheritance allowlist
bounded completion, exit-code capture, and verified Job quiescence
typed provider result and failure surface
exclude: configured workspace grants or ACL mutation
runtime qualification of timeout/output-limit termination and descendant-tree fixtures

authority_delta.filesystem: Qualification-only explicit temporary root used as cwd; no configured workspace grant or ACL mutation
authority_delta.process: Private test-only provider executor; no external or MCP process authority
authority_delta.secrets: Fixed environment allowlist; no Cotra/tunnel secret inheritance

invariants: The executor is unreachable from policy, cotrad, and MCP
The executable is an explicitly validated absolute path and argv is passed without shell interpolation
The child is created suspended in a zero-capability AppContainer
The scrubbed environment excludes Cotra, tunnel, generic secret, and arbitrary caller variables
Only NUL stdin plus the stdout and stderr pipe handles are explicitly inherited through PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST; no ambient inheritable handles are authorized
Job membership and AppContainer token are verified before resume
The qualification child completes within a finite bound and stdout/stderr capture is bounded
The success path returns only after the Job reports zero active processes
All failure paths close owned handles and remove temporary AppContainer profile resources

acceptance.claim: Native Windows tests launch exactly whoami.exe with no arguments without shell interpolation and return bounded stdout/stderr plus exit code.
Tests reject malformed argv, non-absolute executables, cwd escape, invalid limits, and non-allowlisted environment inputs.

Exact-diff implementation and tests bind child inheritance to exactly NUL stdin plus stdout/stderr pipe handles through PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST; sensitive environment keys are excluded from the constructed execution plan.
Native Windows qualification verifies AppContainer token identity and Job membership before resume, then verifies bounded completion and zero active Job processes.
The qualification binds CreateProcessW to the validated workspace cwd; no workspace ACL grant or caller-selected filesystem authority is introduced.
Non-Windows builds remain cfg-isolated and existing policy continues denying process.spawn.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, Jev, and Alibaba Open Code Review gates pass.

done_when: The fixed private bounded executor success path is merged with exact-head and post-merge verification; destructive timeout/output-limit and descendant-tree runtime qualification remain explicit successor work, and no external EXECUTE authority is exposed.
